mcqs.question: A common examiner point on "Conversation and role play" is that a statement is only valid when its condition of applicability is met. Is that TRUE or FALSE?
mcqs.explanation: Every NEB rule has a scope (e.g. a specific range, temperature, or sign convention); stating the condition earns full marks.

examShortTricks: Trick 1: Conversational turns: initiate (greeting), sustain (questions), close (thanks/summary) — showing all three moves is the rubric.
Trick 2: Role-play register: match formality to role (doctor–patient vs friends); inconsistent register is the biggest mark loss.
Trick 3: Active-listening signals: 'Really?', 'I see', echoing a word — these back-channels score communication marks.
